2023 Q3 Sprint Retrospective
In our Q3 sprint retrospective, the team noted significant improvements in deployment speed thanks to the new CI/CD pipeline. However, we identified ongoing challenges with alert noise from Beacon's monitoring thresholds. Action items include refining alert filters and improving documentation for on-call engineers. Customer feedback remains positive overall, highlighting Beacon's reliability improvements.

2023 Q1 Retrospective
In Q1, we focused on improving Beacon's alert system reliability. We faced challenges with false positives, which were addressed by refining sensitivity thresholds. Team communication improved, though some delays in cross-department coordination were noted. Action items include more frequent bug triages and setting up a dedicated Slack channel for urgent issues.

February 2023 All-Hands Meeting Notes
Discussed the upcoming Beacon 3.0 feature rollout scheduled for Q2. Customer feedback from Acme Logistics and Globex led to priority on dashboard customization. Finance shared updates on budget adjustments due to increased server costs. HR reminded everyone about the new remote work policy starting March 2023.

6. Familiarize with internal wiki and Slack channels.

Old How-To: Creating a Beacon Monitor
Log into the Beacon dashboard using your company credentials. Navigate to 'Monitors' and click 'Add New'. Input the website URL and choose monitoring frequency (recommended: every 5 minutes). Set alert preferences including SMS and email notifications. Save and test the monitor to ensure proper setup.

**2023 Q4 Retrospective Summary**
In the Q4 retrospective meeting held on December 15, the team discussed challenges with Beacon's alerting delays and customer feedback regarding UI responsiveness. Key successes included a 20% reduction in false positives and onboarding three new enterprise clients, including Stark Media and Hooli Cloud. Action items focused on improving API latency monitoring and enhancing user documentation. Everyone appreciated the improved cross-team collaboration between DevOps and Customer Support last quarter. Next steps include a dedicated sprint on enhancing mobile notifications in Q1 2024.
